title: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
title_zh: 当所有采样轨迹都失败时：在长时程智能体强化学习中拼接以学习器为条件的局部选项
abstract_en: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often yields all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks: every sampled trajectory receives zero reward, leaving group-relative methods without a reward-based policy gradient. A common remedy supplies complete solutions from a stronger model, but full trajectories are expensive and expose the learner to long off-policy histories. We introduce SPLICE, which constructs local training targets from failed current-policy trajectories online. For each all-fail group, a proposal model selects a splice point in a current-policy trajectory and generates several bounded options from that point. We estimate each option's value using repeated current-policy continuations, convert positive estimates into a return-weighted local target, and fit the current policy on the options. We evaluate SPLICE across two policy families on two long-horizon agent tasks, Software Engineering with SWE-bench Verified and Deep Research with BrowseComp-Plus. SPLICE outperforms GRPO and full-trajectory guidance baselines in all four settings, improving over GRPO by 2.8--9.8 percentage points. On initially failed SWE tasks, it raises GRPO's graduation rate by 10.8 percentage points. Further experiments show that SPLICE improves performance while reducing costly proposal-model computation.
abstract_zh: 在采用可验证奖励的长时程智能体任务中，分组强化学习常遇到组内所有采样轨迹均获零奖励的情况，导致组相对方法无法从奖励中获得策略梯度。常见做法是让更强的模型提供完整解答，但生成完整轨迹成本较高，也会让学习器接触较长的离策略历史。本文提出 SPLICE，利用当前策略生成的失败轨迹在线构造局部训练目标。对于每个全失败组，提案模型在一条当前策略轨迹中选取拼接点，并从该点生成多个长度受限的候选选项。随后用当前策略多次续跑，估计各选项的价值，将估计值为正的选项按回报加权，构造局部目标来训练当前策略。作者在 SWE-bench Verified 软件工程任务和 BrowseComp-Plus 深度研究任务上评估了两个策略系列。SPLICE 在四种设置中均优于 GRPO 和完整轨迹指导基线，较 GRPO 提升 2.8–9.8 个百分点。在最初失败的软件工程任务上，SPLICE 使 GRPO 的后续通过率提高了 10.8 个百分点。进一步实验表明，SPLICE 能在提升表现的同时降低提案模型的计算开销。
key_points_zh: 全失败组内没有奖励差异，GRPO 等组相对方法无法从该组获得基于奖励的策略梯度。
SPLICE 只在失败轨迹的选定位置引入短候选片段，而非让更强模型生成整条解题轨迹。
用当前策略多次接续每个候选片段，衡量学习器能否将该片段转化为回报，再用正回报候选构造加权训练目标。
在两个策略系列与两项任务组成的四种设置中，SPLICE 较 GRPO 提升 2.8–9.8 个百分点；在最初失败的软件工程任务上，后续通过率提高 10.8 个百分点。
相比完整轨迹指导，SPLICE 在提高表现的同时减少了提案模型的计算开销。
